description: Derives a unified fidelity and detected-throughput summary, verifies matrix-to-metric consistency, and renders laboratory, SVD and numerical cross-check density matrices without reacquiring data or repeating optimization.
summary: Combine existing fidelity and throughput results into a verified summary.

twoQubitDensityMatrix.description: Declared physical state output from ReconstructTwoQubitDensityMatrix.

entangledPairFidelity.description: Declared output from EstimateEntangledPairFidelity for that state, including svdLocalUnitary.rhoOptimized and crossCheck.numericLocalUnitary.bestAttempt.parameters.

distillableEntanglementRate.description: Declared successful output from EstimateEntangledPairDistillableEntanglementRate for the same reconstruction/observation.

writeToArtifactRoot.description: Write summary artifacts in this protocol's run directory rather than its stage subdirectory; never the ancestor's or entire run-plan directory.

entanglement.fidelity.estimate.entangled.description: Aggregate of labFrameFidelity, fullyEntangledFraction, frameMisalignmentFidelityLoss, numerical crossCheck (no delta), detected hashing throughput, three frame matrices and input provenance. Verifies their reported overlaps with the preserved 1e-7 tolerance; no new physical acceptance gate.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.entangled.description: Markdown summary with links to the three density-matrix figures.
Three paired PNG/SVG signed-3D real/imaginary matrix plots on common scales with numeric labels and dashed ideal Phi+ references. Only labFrame represents the measured frame.
